assets.label: 坍塌木支护
assets.assetType: World-126 abandoned-mine path-blocking collapsed timber support obstacle
assets.paletteConstraint: damp desaturated dark oak posts and brace, matte blackened iron bands, charcoal slate rockfall and restrained brown oxidation only.
assets.styleScopeRequest: apply mine materials only to the existing two posts, crossbeam, diagonal brace, iron bands and connected rockfall; preserve every open gap in the support frame.
assets.primaryRequest: one collapsed underground mine timber-support obstacle formed by two heavy posts, one cracked crossbeam, one diagonal brace, iron bands and one compact connected slate rockfall
assets.structureRequest: preserve exactly two vertical timber posts, one top crossbeam, one diagonal timber brace, the authored iron bands and one connected four-mass rockfall inside the supplied footprint; keep the open frame gaps visible and add no third post, wall, tunnel, roof, rail or detached rubble
assets.detailRequest: refine the same collapsed support with restrained split oak grain, worn iron bands, chipped damp slate and sparse oxidation without changing any beam, gap, rock mass or footprint
assets.negativeRequest: no intact tunnel set, no enclosed wall, no extra support frame, no minecart, no machinery, no lantern, no loose tools and no detached rubble beyond the Depth silhouette

assets.label: 脱轨满载矿车
assets.assetType: World-126 abandoned-mine path-blocking derailed loaded ore-cart obstacle
assets.paletteConstraint: charcoal riveted iron cart, muted orange-brown oxidation, dark oak sleepers, black rails and non-glowing dark slate ore only.
assets.styleScopeRequest: apply mine materials only to the existing cart body, four wheels, two short rails, four sleepers and connected ore load.
assets.primaryRequest: one derailed abandoned ore minecart obstacle with a loaded riveted cart, four iron wheels, two short rails, four sleepers and one compact dark ore load
assets.structureRequest: preserve exactly one trapezoid cart body, exactly four visible wheel assemblies, exactly two short parallel rails, exactly four cross sleepers and the authored four-piece ore load; retain the supplied slight tilt and keep every part inside the rectangular footprint; add no second cart, track extension, locomotive or detached cargo
assets.detailRequest: refine the same loaded cart with broad worn iron panels, readable rivets, restrained rust, split sleeper grain and chipped dark ore without changing the cart angle, wheel count, rails or footprint
assets.negativeRequest: no second cart, no tunnel, no building, no rail line continuing outside the footprint, no crane, no character, no loose tool pile and no spilled ore outside the Depth silhouette

assets.label: 天然岩柱簇
assets.assetType: World-126 abandoned-mine path-blocking natural slate pillar cluster obstacle
assets.paletteConstraint: low-saturation charcoal and cool-gray stratified slate with faint damp mineral sheen only; no colored crystal or emissive light.
assets.styleScopeRequest: treat every supplied mass as one fused natural slate formation; keep the low connected base and four authored pillar masses distinct.
assets.primaryRequest: one compact natural cave slate-pillar cluster obstacle with one dominant blunt pillar, three lower fused stone fins and one connected low rocky base
assets.structureRequest: preserve exactly one dominant central pillar, exactly three lower fused pillar masses and one low connected base inside the supplied footprint; every mass remains solid natural rock with no opening, arch, carved face, platform or detached stone
assets.detailRequest: refine the same pillar cluster with broad stratified slate planes, chipped edges, sparse damp mineral variation and restrained crevice darkness without changing any pillar count, height hierarchy or footprint
assets.negativeRequest: no cave opening, no arch, no doorway, no timber, no metal, no crystals, no glowing seam, no statue, no carved rune and no detached rubble

assets.structureRequest: preserve exactly two timber A-frames, exactly two long base runners, one central horizontal drum with its authored flanges and cable rings, one side crank wheel, one axle and one handle; keep the frame spaces open and add no roof, platform, second drum or hanging cargo
